name: Generate explicit or harmful fictional narratives
description: Users asked for the generation of fictional narratives, scripts, or roleplay scenarios featuring explicit sexual content, graphic violence, non-consensual themes, or crude humor involving bodily functions. Many requests involved characters from specific fictional franchises or original custom characters, and several included attempts to bypass safety filters through jailbreak prompts or detailed instructions to ignore ethical guidelines.
